name: a-body-begun-on-a-later-line-is-a-sentence
query:
:number/plus |~~ Adds by. ~~|
  ::fn
  | takes :by |~~ How much. ~~| /0
  | impl ~(add by)
| 5 | plus 3

name: the-chain-of-a-kind-is-the-body-of-a-bare-name-with-its-page
query:
:Box
  |~~ A box. ~~|
  ::kind
    | accepts |~~ The sizes. ~~| ::map
| ::Box"x" !| tag

name: a-chain-on-the-line-of-a-name-with-a-path-is-refused-naming-its-parentheses
query: ":number/plus ::fn | takes :by |~~ b ~~| /0 | impl ~(add by) | 5 | plus 3" | parse !| message
expect: "the body of `:number/plus` on the line of its name is one step, `::fn`, and the commands after it are steps of the query: a chain stands in parentheses, `:number/plus (::fn | …)`"

name: a-chain-on-the-line-of-a-bare-name-is-refused-naming-its-parentheses
expect: "the body of `:x` on the line of its name is one step, `::Box`, and the commands after it are steps of the query: a chain stands in parentheses, `:x (::Box | …)`"

name: a-chain-on-the-line-of-a-bare-name-with-its-page-is-refused-naming-its-parentheses
expect: "the body of `:Box` on the line of its name is one step, `::kind`, and the commands after it are steps of the query: a chain stands in parentheses, `:Box (::kind | …)`"

name: a-value-after-the-commands-that-follow-no-chain-is-refused-as-a-value
expect: "a step is a command: a value stands at the head, where it is the subject, or as what a verb takes"
